 ☐ Comp-history

│ The computer-history error is a bug in OpenAI's Computer Use helper, not in your setup: your Codex CLI (0.154.0) sends a new handshake field the helper can't read yet. Your desktop app
│ (0.153.4) doesn't send that field, so it works fine there. How do you want to handle it?
